_comment: Enterprise (production) mode with an OIDC provider. Secrets/IDs are injected from env vars (${...}) so this file is safe to commit. Provide them via a gitignored .env.local and run: set -a && source .env.local && set +a && GATEWAY_CONFIG=./config/gateway.oidc.json npm start. Register the redirect URI <publicUrl>/auth/callback/azure in your IdP. authorization (Casbin RBAC) is ON; roles/bindings live in storage — seed them with: mcp-gateway migrate seed --from ./config/gateway.oidc.json --policy ./config/policy.csv --force. Grant a user admin with a `g, <email>, admin` binding.
